goal.objective: Run one governance-complete implementation round as a finite acyclic graph with mechanical byte evidence, independent review, globally bounded revision and self-evolution, and controller-finalized state-bound completion proof.
goal.acceptance: The supplied focused-check argv succeeds without shell interpretation, every writing path passes the required independent reviews against the task criteria, the archive node emits only a proof candidate marker, and the controller binds the final proof to the reviewed workspace bytes.

admission.demotionCondition: Use a native subagent when the task does not need the byte-evidence chain, multiple independent verdict stages, reviewed self-evolution, or machine-controlled state-bound completion.

sideEffects.effect: controller-owned baseline artifact under the run directory
sideEffects.recovery: Reconcile by stable run and node id and verify the frozen baseline digest before reuse.

sideEffects.owner: implement-r0-u0 and statically unrolled implementation nodes
sideEffects.recovery: Reconcile current bytes against the frozen baseline before authorizing a new bounded attempt.

sideEffects.effect: controller-owned acceptance and byte-evidence artifacts under the run directory
sideEffects.recovery: Treat an interrupted capture as ambiguous; verify the exact artifact digest before continuing.

sideEffects.effect: reviewed framework, skill, agent, flow, lemma, or memory writes
sideEffects.recovery: Validate the claimed lemma state and review the actual byte diff before continuing.

sideEffects.effect: controller-owned proof-candidate marker only; it does not write or claim the protected PM proof
sideEffects.recovery: The controller verifies the terminal, final review, evidence, and frozen bytes before idempotent proof finalization.

evidence: pre-write root and nested-workspace byte baseline path, digest, and summary
post-implementation mechanical acceptance and byte evidence for every traversal
independent reward-hacking verdict over the implementation and its evidence capture
independent self-evolution verdict with one global retry across all traversals
final post-write byte evidence and reward-hacking verdict over every causal final-byte writer
controller-created proof candidate and controller-finalized state-bound completion proof
